# AEL spec: design before code

One skill, one stage at a time. Pick the stage from the user's words (`/ael-spec review`, "draft the design doc"). If it is unclear, ask with the host's question buttons. Read only that stage's reference, then follow it.

| Stage | When | Read |
|---|---|---|
| `brainstorm` | a half-baked idea; produce a concepts brief | `references/spec-brainstorm.md` |
| `draft` | a brief or notes; write the design doc section by section (template: `references/design_doc.md`) | `references/spec-draft.md` |
| `review` | a design doc; one round of fresh Goldfish reviews | `references/spec-review.md` |
| `review loop` | a design doc; review, fix and review again until it is clean | `references/spec-review-loop.md` |
| `resolve` | reviewer reports; apply the fixes the human accepts | `references/spec-resolve.md` |
| `drift` | existing design docs; check them against the code | `references/spec-drift.md` |

After a reviewed design: `npx ai-engineering-loop goal draft --from-design <doc.md>` turns it into a Goal (`npx ai-engineering-loop docs spec-pack`).
